semanticChecks: Cubicle appearance does not establish internal equipment or voltage; transformers, switching equipment, breakers and disconnectors remain distinct; opening one device does not establish all upstream/downstream deenergized.
Outage indication and lights-off do not prove absence of voltage; multiple supplies, surrounding live parts and residual charge retained; old tests do not authorize current work.
Short circuits apply to three-phase, single-phase and DC; intentional grounding differs from ground fault; leakage alarm does not identify cause or repair it.
Wire/terminal fit does not prove material/structure/size suitability; tool body, dies, retention, electrical performance and system current conditions remain separate.
Overhead wires are elevated lines with unverified type; boom/bed motion changes envelope; no-contact photograph or covers do not authorize approach/contact.
Road-use versus road-occupation permits retain distinct purpose/authority; permit scope, time changes, pedestrians, vehicles and actual site safety checks remain distinct.

Work stopping does not complete road opening management; cover versus fence functions separated; cover load capacity unverified; stored materials displacement/scattering and night visibility/noise remain separate.
limitations: AI translation and author self-review only. No independent native-speaker, technical, rights or release approval. Translates authored Japanese without independently updating technical/legal guidance.
